{{short description|Polish mathematician and professor}}
[[File:Kajetan Garbiński.jpg|thumb|Kajetan Garbiński]]
'''Kajetan Garbiński''' (1796–1847) was a Polish mathematician and prominent professor at the [[University of Warsaw]]. Minister of religion and education in the revolutionary [[Polish National Government (November Uprising)|Polish National Government]] during the [[November Uprising]] in 1831.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=9vtIAAAAcAAJ|title=Przegląd poznański: pismo sześciotygodniowe|date=1850|publisher=Kamieński|volume=10|pages=253|language=pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last=Bieliński|first=Józef|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=5lMoAAAAYAAJ|title=Królewski Uniwersytet Warszawski (1816-1831)|date=1907|publisher=E. Wende i Ska|language=pl}}</ref>
